- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The collaboration faced challenges regarding clearance issues for the sample used in the song, which was taken from the funk band "Zapp & Roger."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The band's estate initially denied clearance to use the sample, but Too Short negotiated and made a personal phone call to secure it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There were also artistic differences between Too Short and Jay-Z, but they were able to compromise and create a successful collaboration.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The sample has also been used by other artists in different genres, including The Chemical Brothers and The Game.
